Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixed general Smart Action no-ops in enabled Wolves' Den testing. FFXIV's native zero/default selected-target carrier is now accepted only after resolving the exact current hostile duel opponent or reviewed dummy. Smart Action admission and final safety now share one closed policy for every current damaging non-ground-target shape: direct, target-circle, and cone/line/other AoE, cast or instant. This covers BLM's final Fire AoE and SAM Ogi/Kaeshi: Namikiri. Exact Chiten checks remain active; Guard, Cover, PLD LB, and DRK LB remain candidate-local blockers. CC ranking and Chase are unchanged. Automated checks are separate from live in-game confirmation.
